相处：分享一层含蓄的理解，给对方重新解释人物的自由。 容许两种读法并存，先把理由说完整。

Keep shoes and hands readable without a spotlight or glowing contour. Rain is weather, not automatic sadness, tears or a new story.
Every material shares this environment: character skin/hair/uniform/eyes, held paper/book/pen, linen/wood, the chair/bench supports, shoes and adjacent floor. Keep original uniform local colors and youthful anime identity; white collars/pages receive the real ambient exposure rather than glowing daylight-white. No simple color filter, sunny cutout pasted on a dark background, half-day/half-night seam, gray/gold wash, arbitrary neon or new spotlight.

Preserve refined youthful 2D anime linework and soft modeled shading naturally integrated with the detailed literary-room illustration. Entire frame, true source scale and support, no second person/extra limb, no UI, labels, icons, logo, watermark, collage, border, fog or new props.
